Menlo Park's 135 Constitution Dr is not a walkable transfer from downtown San Francisco, and Oakland requires a separate cross-bay travel plan. Within SF, group venues by Mission Rock, Dogpatch, Union Square or downtown. Check the return trip before adding an evening event. Map pins identify venues, not entrances or travel directions.
